artists.biography: Booker T. & the M.G.'s is an instrumental R&B band that was influential in shaping the sound of southern soul and Memphis soul. Original members of the group were Booker T. Jones (organ, piano), Steve Cropper (guitar), Lewie Steinberg (bass), and Al Jackson, Jr. (drums). In the 1960s, as members of the house band of Stax Records, they played on hundreds of recordings by artists such as Wilson Pickett, Otis Redding, Bill Withers, Sam & Dave, Carla and Rufus Thomas and Johnnie Taylor. They also released instrumental records under their own name, such as the 1962 hit single "Green Onions". As originators of the unique Stax sound, the group was one of the most prolific, respected, and imitated of their era. By the mid-1960s, bands on both sides of the Atlantic were trying to sound like Booker T. & the M.G.'s.

perplexity.description:
Green Onions is the debut album by Booker T. & the M.G.'s, originally released in October 1962 on Stax Records. The album is a landmark in the Funk/Soul genre, defined by its tight, instrumental grooves and the signature sound of Booker T. Jones’ Hammond M3 organ, Steve Cropper’s Fender Telecaster guitar, Lewis Steinberg’s bass, and Al Jackson Jr.’s drums. The title track, “Green Onions,” became an iconic R&B instrumental, built on a twelve-bar blues progression and marked by its hypnotic organ riff and crisp, soulful guitar work. The album’s sound helped shape the Memphis soul style and set a template for instrumental soul and funk music.

As the first album released on the Stax label, Green Onions holds a pivotal place in both the band’s discography and the broader history of American soul music. It was the group’s first charting album, reaching number 33 on the Billboard 200, and established Booker T. & the M.G.'s as one of the most influential backing bands of the era. The album’s critical acclaim has endured, with its inclusion in essential listening guides such as Robert Dimery’s 1001 Albums You Must Hear Before You Die. Its original 1962 release remains a touchstone for fans of instrumental soul and funk.
